description.value: Accent Inns Victoria is a BC-owned family hotel that explicitly markets itself as bike-friendly, offering free bike rentals to all guests as part of its standard amenity package. The hotel sits near Mile 0 of the Trans-Canada Highway, making it a symbolically significant stop for touring cyclists completing or beginning long-distance routes. It is Rainbow Registered, strongly pet-friendly, and features an on-site restaurant for evening meals.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: staple (4 spaces) at 3m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms active operation with 'Bike friendly with free bike rentals' explicitly listed as a standard amenity, free in-room WiFi, coin-operated laundry, and an on-site restaurant (Bin 4 Burger Lounge). The phone (250.475.7500) and address (3233 Maple St, Victoria, BC) on the website match the OSM tags. No website passage describes secure overnight storage for guests' own touring bikes — only free rental bikes are mentioned — so secure storage and staff bike procedure are null.
concerns: OSM tags the property as 'motel' but the website consistently uses 'hotel'; no practical impact on the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating hotel with confirmed web presence, explicit bike-friendly branding including free bike rentals, and proximity to Trans-Canada Highway Mile 0 — clearly useful to touring cyclists.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Website explicitly states guests can bring bikes to their rooms ('Love your bike? Bring it to your room. No need to leave it in storage where you can't see it') by requesting a bike-friendly room at reservation

Laundry.detail: Coin-operated laundry on-site, plus same-day valet dry-cleaning service (Monday–Saturday)

Nearby evening food.detail: Bin 4 Burger Lounge is an on-site restaurant with burgers, gluten-free and vegetarian options, Victoria craft beers, and cocktails

Bikes in rooms.detail: Website explicitly invites guests to bring bikes to their rooms as part of the Bike Love program; guests request a 'bike-friendly room' at booking

Basic tools.detail: Website lists 'shop-quality, 37-piece tool kit at your disposal to do everything from tire changes and brake adjustments to headset overhauls' plus rags for cleaning

Bike wash / hose.detail: Website confirms 'bicycle wash and tuning station with a professional-grade bike stand' available at every Accent Inns location

wow_evidence: Bike friendly with free bike rentals explicitly listed as a standard amenity
